title: Research: prove query-series support-transfer closure
body:
## Summary

```text
marked source/reader transfer
  -> unmarked parallel duplication uses OR subset collapse
  -> unmarked series splitting uses AND subset collapse
  -> finite induction allows arbitrary query count and augmented rank
  -> non-Fano pair reader bill stays at least m_A + m_B
```

Prove a query-rewrite closure lemma and apply PR3506's two-mark non-Fano premise beyond the five-term/rank-three regime of PR3513. A literal six-term control has factor ranks (4,4), exact endpoint diag(1,1,0,0), and charges [2,0,4,4,2,2], totaling 14 against the pair floor 4. This example is not an optimum or a saving.

Only unmarked queries may be rewritten. Every series split adds an independent direction. Arbitrary rank-four configurations, marked-target splits, physical suppliers and kappa remain open. The proof includes the independent-direction boundary counterexample. Exact predecessor proof/template bytes and credit are retained as mathematical premises; handoff comparisons are separate.

## Evidence

- **Before:** PR3513 leaves rank-(4,4) six-term pair factorizations outside its rank-three argument.
  **After:** The written closure proof covers every finite series/parallel expansion of a transferable query configuration, including non-Fano expansions with arbitrarily high rank. The retained non-Fano minor prevents reducing this application to PR3505's full-representability criterion.
- Two separate implementations agree on all 255 finite cases, 7,424 source and 17,216 reader premises, the complete ordered hash and actual rectangular witness bill. Ten optimized CLI corruptions reject; four positive runs pass before/after restoration.
- CPython 3.12.15 direct and registered replay, metadata/source pins, exact final-head source-history gate, focused Ruff and formatting checks pass. The committed Git-free export passes all three scientific/control commands with PATH=/nonexistent and immutable source/export hashes. The separate maximum-Ruff diagnostic and scoped deviations are recorded in VALIDATION.md.

Replay from the repository root:

```sh
python3.12 scripts/research_package.py --package research/p112-query-series-transfer
python3.12 scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/p112-query-series-transfer --check-source-history
```

The README gives direct Git-free replay and export commands. [Canonical investigation](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1587#discussioncomment-19010984). No selected cold replay, physical invoice, independent human or formal proof-kernel acceptance is claimed.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

**Blast Radius:** isolated

Fifteen new files in research/p112-query-series-transfer. Frozen inputs, shared tooling and the selected frontier are unchanged. The universal closure is a written proof with finite controls; it remains subject to mathematical review.
